verdict.rationale: Veriff supports event-driven automation via webhooks (session/event/decision/watchlist webhooks) and an explicit no-code Zapier integration described as enabling users to 'automate workflows based on end-user verification decisions,' which lets users define trigger-action rules across apps without custom code. However, there's no evidence of a native rules/conditions engine inside Veriff itself — automation depends on webhooks requiring custom backend logic or a third-party tool (Zapier) rather than an in-product rule builder. Missing for 10: native conditional rule engine within Veriff's own platform, documentation of rule complexity/logic operators, and independent evidence of real-world automation workflows built this way.
